scripts.text:
# My Reel Script

## Hook (first 2 seconds)
Stop scrolling — this one change doubled my reply rate.

## Script
1. I used to send the same cold DM to everyone.
2. Then I tried one thing: mention something specific from their last post.
3. Not flattery — one real detail that shows you actually looked.
4. My reply rate went from 4% to 12% in a week.
5. Try it on your next five DMs. You'll feel the difference.

## Inserts
- Beat 2: screenshot of generic vs personalized DM
- Beat 4: simple bar chart — 4% → 12%

(Pause after beat 1 — let it land)

# Launch demo — 60 seconds

## Hook
I built this in two weeks. Here is the whole thing in one minute.

## Script
1. The problem: you have a list of things to do, and it lives in six places.
2. This puts the list in one file your tools and your AI can both read.
3. Add a task from the terminal — it shows up on the board.
4. Ask your agent what is due this week — it reads the same file.
5. Link in the first reply. It is free and it is open source.

## Inserts
- Beat 3: terminal on the left, board on the right
- Beat 4: chat window asking "what is due this week?"

## Prep
- [x] Script locked
- [ ] Record screen
- [ ] Captions
